data.name: BlackCore
data.teaser: New black (or close to) variants of weapon mods and gear
data.description:
SPT/EFT is currently in a volatile state for content mods. This makes it very challenging to keep up with updating custom items. New scripts are added to gear, weapons, etc, every update. Stay on SPT 3.10 for the best experience when it comes to these kinds of mods.

The weapon paints are only available in SPT versions below SPT 3.11. This is due to BSG implementing skins to the game. The asset bundles for modded weapons stopped working, so I had to remove them from BlackCore for the mod to function. From 3.11, only black weapon attachments were added.

Turn FDE attachments, weapons, and gear in the game to black with BlackCore, over 50 items retextured with some of them adding a new spice to the textures. Topographic lines, skulls, etc. A lot of effort went into making these retextures. Enjoy!

How you install this mod:

Download Painter

Drag the folder in the zip file into your SPT directory

Download this mod

Drag the folder in the zip file into your SPT directory

You did it!

If you use custom load order, you have to make sure Painter is loading before my other mods.

versions.description:
- Fixed black GPNVG not working
- Fixed black SIG Tango scope not showing reticle

Updated for SPT 3.11

- I had to remove A LOT of bugged items due to BSG adding a lot of new scripts and animations to weapons and gear. All weapon presets are now gone. All black vests are also removed. This is because they added too many new animations and scripts in the asset bundles, which we can't update yet due to an outdated SPT SDK. It's still possible but it would take me around 300 hours. Not doing that.
- If you want the best experience of my customization mods, you have to stay on SPT 3.10 or older.
- Only weapon attachments and some gear items are now included in BlackCore 1.1.7.

- Removed black AUG because there is one in EFT now (make sure to delete weapon presets where the black aug is used and in stash)
- Added default presets for all painted weapons
- Added black GPNVG (Will be added to helmets in TGC soon)
- Added painted weapons to be counted in Elimination quests where the original weapon has to be used. This does not include Gunsmith quests

<del>  
</del>

<del>I need help with testing this release against a new fresh profile in SPT 3.10.5. To see if the mastering tab works like it should.</del>

**UPDATE**

Now the mastering tab works!

- Fixed mod structure to be more updated with the new SPT environment
- Added the Tango6 scope, black texture version
Fixed Razor HD scope to be compatible with the new variable zoom mechanic
Updated for SPT 3.10 - All items now use MONGOID

- Added a new variant of Vortex UH-1 sight, the original has a purple/blue tint
- Added a new variant of GL CORE stock, making it much darker
- Fixed ugly texture/material for the AR-15 Carbon handguard
- Increased pricing for Black SPEAR preset
- Increased pricing for multiple M4A1 presets
- Increased pricing for Black AUG preset
- Increased pricing for R11 rifle preset

[![MI04sNm.jpeg](https://i.imgur.com/MI04sNm.jpeg)](https://i.imgur.com/MI04sNm.jpeg)

- Updated for SPT 3.9.0
- This release will not work on previous versions of SPT

- Added Lancer magazines to Remington R11 RSASS
- Added Ars Arma CPC MOD.1 plate carrier (Black)
- 5.11 Tactical TacTec plate carrier (Black)
- WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Black)
- Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Black)
- Added a new version of the pristine M4A1 receiver and lower

![so41mXE.jpeg](https://i.imgur.com/so41mXE.jpeg)

**Fixes**

- Changed some textures for SIG SPEAR. Made the silencer and charging handle darker
- Made Magpul SL-K black stock darker
- Updated unlock loyalty levels for the new version of Painter

**New items**

- Added black balaclava
- Added gradient sunglasses
